component.name: berth
component.summary: A lightweight terminal with workspaces, tabs and splits

description.p: berth is a GPU-accelerated terminal emulator built in Rust on alacritty_terminal. It adds a workspace sidebar, tab strip, split panes, scrollback search, themes and sandboxed WASM plugins on top of a standards-compliant VT engine.

Configuration is hot-reloading TOML: fonts, line height, ANSI palettes, light/dark presets, shell command and keybindings. The renderer targets a low memory and startup footprint and never uses a web view.
Theme presets, real font faces, scrollback search, clickable links, kitty keyboard protocol and capability-gated WASM plugins.
